laws.name: Florida Pregnancy Discrimination & Accommodation Protections
laws.description: Florida law prohibits discrimination based on pregnancy and requires employers to provide reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions.

laws.name: Florida Domestic Violence Leave
laws.description: Employers with 50 or more employees must provide up to 3 days of leave in a 12‑month period for employees dealing with domestic or sexual violence issues affecting themselves or a family member.

laws.name: Florida Jury Duty Leave
laws.description: Employers must allow employees to take leave for jury service. Employers may not discharge or threaten employees for serving.

laws.name: Florida Military Leave
laws.description: Florida provides job‑protected leave for military service, including National Guard and Reserve duty, in addition to federal USERRA protections.

laws.name: Florida Voting Leave (Employer Discretion)
laws.description: Florida does not require paid voting leave, but employers may not interfere with an employee’s right to vote.

laws.name: Florida School Activities Leave (Local Policies)
laws.description: Florida does not mandate statewide school activities leave, but many public employers provide it by policy.
